visualCharacteristics: Shallow full-width hero with a background photograph, a 50% dark overlay, an accent bar, a large heading, and one or more CTA buttons. Text is left-aligned and reversed (light on dark).
contentPattern: 1 row / 1 column containing a background image (picture), a heading, an optional paragraph, and CTA links.
usage: Page-top hero banner for landing/FAQ pages with a photographic background and calls to action.
